{{Quote|I'm staking out these thugs. I have to figure out a way to get the goods they've stolen back to their rightful owners. Hey, maybe you can help. Would you go into that camp and recover the stolen goods for me?|Sergeant Hus, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RSG" />}}
'''Sola Hus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] officer of the [[Corellian Security Force]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:RSG" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Hus was investigating some thefts committed by the [[Braggan's Fist]] thugs. He hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to recover stolen goods from the [[Braggan's Fist Camp]] camp near [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]]. The spacer succeed in the mission and Sola Hus was very grateful, hoping to get a promotion and leave off bookkeeping work.<ref name="SWG:RSG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sola Hus appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RSG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Sola Hus was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
